ext_description.message: Runs the collection missions of your PNeX organization in its own tabs, one tab per site, at a human pace.

setup_intro.message: Sign in to your PNeX server to pair this browser. One browser agent per computer.

one_agent_per_computer.message: Keep a single browser agent on this computer. Its tabs are grouped under "PNeX": leave them open.

permissions_hint.message: A mission needs these sites. Allow each one so the agent can read it.

no_missions.message: No mission yet: create one in PNeX, page Browser agents.

error_server_invalid.message: Enter the address of your PNeX server, starting with https://.

error_permission_denied.message: The extension needs access to your PNeX server: accept the browser prompt.

error_login_timeout.message: Sign-in took too long: try again.

error_extension_pair_refused.message: Pairing refused: reinstall the extension and try again.

error_extension_install_paired_elsewhere.message: This browser is already paired with another organization: remove its browser agent there first.

error_extension_write_forbidden.message: Viewers cannot pair a browser: ask an owner, admin or member.

state_ext_selector_not_found.message: selector matches nothing on the page
